description.name: Entry
description.text: Ten single attacks (0.71 each), damages the user for 99% current HP, grants [Stoneskin: 100%], [Attach Dark] and [Red Wings EX Mode] to the user

description.name: Stoneskin: 100%
description.text: Reduces damage taken to 0, up to an amount equal to 100% of the character's maximum HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Attach Dark
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Dark damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Dark resistance +20%

description.name: Red Wings EX Mode
description.text: ATK +30%, cast speed x3.00 for Darkness abilities, Darkness abilities trigger 1 additional time, removed if the character doesn't have any Stoneskin
